description: This file defines the Manufacturer controller class for the catalog namespace in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, editing, and managing manufacturer data, such as fetching manufacturer details, handling form submissions, and generating views for the admin interface.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class for managing manufacturers within the Opencart admin catalog namespace. Provides methods for listing, editing, and displaying manufacturer data.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class for managing manufacturers within the Opencart admin catalog namespace. Provides methods for listing, editing, deleting, and autocompleting manufacturer data, including SEO URL management and layout assignments.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the manufacturer list page in the admin interface.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturers, typically as a JSON response for asynchronous requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML view for the manufacturer list, including filters, pagination, and data rows.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a manufacturer.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Prepares and returns the data needed to render the add/edit manufacturer form, including manufacturer details and related data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a manufacturer, including SEO URL and layout data.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Prepares and returns the data needed to render the add/edit manufacturer form, such as manufacturer details, SEO URL, layouts, and language options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or editing) manufacturer data, including permission checks, SEO URL management, and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected manufacturers after permission validation and returns JSON response.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete JSON response for manufacturer search, with filtering by name.
